title: Hanse on Smith BOD Feedback
bodyHtml:
We'll post more information on the rewards system at a later date.

The main complaint we've seen is that players would rather see a predictable pattern to the rewards (many folks have charts on the reward ranges for BOD's). Predictability is something we're looking into resolving.

However, this will make it slightly easier to predict your reward. So, from a trading and collecting standpoint, it may make it easier to get your reward (such as a powerscroll), but the cost in deed type is not decreasing for blacksmiths.



Hanse가 UOSS포럼에서 말하기를 슴스보상품의 불평으로 인해
보상품을 받는 것들에 대해 재배치를 할것을 고려중이라고 합니다.

예를들어. 스미스 파워스크롤같은것이 나오기가 어렵다는 것인데 이것 또한 조정한다는 의미입니다.
